body.rationale:
1 blocking issue(s):
- Claim refuted: No behavior change.

claims.text: Use integer division in average to avoid floating point noise.

claim_results.explanation: The test suite results and code execution do not provide evidence that integer division was used or that it affects the performance in terms of avoiding floating point noise.

Behavior differs: average([1, 2, 3, 4]) returned 2.5 on base but returned 2 on head; average([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]) returned 2.5 on base but returned 2.0 on head; average([1.1, 2.2, 3.3, 4.4]) returned 2.75 on base but returned 2.0 on head

findings.title: Claim refuted: No behavior change.
findings.detail: Behavior differs: average([1, 2, 3, 4]) returned 2.5 on base but returned 2 on head; average([1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0]) returned 2.5 on base but returned 2.0 on head; average([1.1, 2.2, 3.3, 4.4]) returned 2.75 on base but returned 2.0 on head

findings.title: Claim not verified: Use integer division in average to avoid floating point noise.
findings.detail: The test suite results and code execution do not provide evidence that integer division was used or that it affects the performance in terms of avoiding floating point noise.
